findings.title: 7 text element(s) fail colour contrast on /
findings.detail: Lowest ratio 2.4:1 (needs 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text). 4% of checked text fails.
findings.fix: Darken text or lighten backgrounds to meet WCAG 1.4.3 contrast minimums.

findings.title: 1 control(s) without an accessible name on /
findings.detail: Screen-reader users hear only “button” or “link” with no purpose.
findings.fix: Add visible text, aria-label, or alt text on icon images inside the control.

findings.title: No visible focus indicator on 11/24 sampled controls (/)
findings.detail: Keyboard users cannot see where they are on the page.
findings.fix: Never remove outlines without replacement — use :focus-visible with a high-contrast ring.

findings.principle: Hick's Law · Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall
findings.title: Hesitation over “someone@example.com”
findings.detail: User hovered for 9.2 s without acting — a sign of uncertainty about what this control does or what will happen.
findings.fix: Clarify the label, add helper text or a preview of the outcome; reduce ambiguity between similar options.

findings.principle: Hick's Law · Nielsen #6 Recognition rather than recall

findings.detail: User hovered for 6.4 s without acting — a sign of uncertainty about what this control does or what will happen.
findings.fix: Clarify the label, add helper text or a preview of the outcome; reduce ambiguity between similar options.

findings.title: 12 tap/click target(s) smaller than 24×24 px on /
findings.detail: Small targets take longer to acquire and cause mis-taps, especially on touch.
findings.fix: Make targets at least 24×24 px (44×44 px for touch); add padding rather than enlarging icons.

findings.principle: Nielsen #5 & #9 — Error prevention; help users recover
findings.title: 44 console error(s)
findings.detail: Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found) · Cache with key LOCATION does not exist · Cache with key LOCATION does not exist
findings.fix: Investigate console errors — they often signal broken features users silently hit.

findings.title: Field friction: “loginfmt”
findings.detail: Focused 3×, 0 deletions vs 28 keystrokes, 23.5 s total. Users are struggling with the expected format or meaning.
findings.fix: Show the expected format up front (example/mask), validate inline as the user types, and accept flexible input.

findings.title: Form started but not submitted (3 fields touched)
findings.detail: On /e0b26355-1889-40d8-8ef1-e559616befda/oauth2/v2.0/authorize the user interacted with 3 fields but never submitted.
findings.fix: Reduce the number of fields, show progress, save drafts, and make the primary action obvious.

findings.title: Form started but not submitted (2 fields touched)
findings.detail: On /uld-load-progress the user interacted with 2 fields but never submitted.
findings.fix: Reduce the number of fields, show progress, save drafts, and make the primary action obvious.

findings.principle: WCAG 3.3.2 Labels · Nielsen #6 Recognition over recall
findings.title: 1 form field(s) without a label on /uld-load-progress
findings.detail: 1 rely only on placeholder text, which disappears on input and burdens memory.
findings.fix: Use persistent visible <label>s above fields; keep placeholders for examples only.

evidence.text: Search for ULD no, destinations, etc.

findings.title: Layout shift CLS 0.13 on /uld-load-progress
findings.detail: Content moves while users are reading or about to click — a common cause of mis-clicks.
findings.fix: Reserve space for images, ads and async content; avoid inserting content above existing content.

findings.title: 1 image(s) missing alt attribute on /e0b26355-1889-40d8-8ef1-e559616befda/oauth2/v2.0/authorize
findings.detail: Images without alt are announced by file name or skipped unpredictably.
findings.fix: Add descriptive alt text, or alt="" for purely decorative images.

findings.title: Navigation with 11 items on /
findings.detail: Decision time grows with the number of choices. Long flat menus are hard to scan and remember.
findings.fix: Group into 5–9 top-level categories; move secondary items into sub-menus or a footer.

findings.title: 59 interactive elements above the fold on /
findings.detail: A dense first screen competes for attention and dilutes the primary action.
findings.fix: Prioritise one primary call-to-action; reduce or de-emphasise secondary options.

findings.title: 57 buttons compete above the fold on /
findings.detail: Without a clear primary action users must evaluate every option.
findings.fix: Use one visually dominant primary button; style the rest as secondary/tertiary.

findings.title: Slow response: 264 ms after pointerup
findings.detail: Interaction took 264 ms to paint the next frame (Doherty threshold is 400 ms; INP “good” is ≤ 200 ms).
findings.fix: Break up long tasks, defer non-critical work, and render optimistic UI immediately.

findings.title: Dead click on “Sign in Can’t access your account? Sign-in options”
findings.detail: 1 click produced no visible change (no DOM update, no navigation) within 1 s. The element is not interactive, but users treat it as if it is.
findings.fix: Users expect this to be clickable. Link it to the obvious destination or restyle it so it no longer looks actionable.
